dataset_name: Executive Operations Call Volume & Demand Dataset
description: Multi-year aggregated operations and call center performance data (2023-2026), fully anonymized.

Date.description: The specific calendar date of the operational log.

Day.description: Day of the week (e.g., Monday, Tuesday, etc.).

Taken.description: Total number of calls or operational requests handled during the given period.

Year.description: Extracted four-digit calendar year for macro filtering.

Month.description: Full name of the month (e.g., January, February).
